newsitem.title: USA: Aasche Transportation names Larry Asche as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Aasche Transportation names Larry Asche as CEO.

text.p: Aasche Transportation Services Inc said Tuesday that Larry Asche was appointed chief executive officer of the company, succeeding Kevin Clark, who will continue as president.
This move and a recent promotion of Daniel Wright to chief operating officer completes the company's realignment of titles, Aasche said in a statement.

Aasche provides temperature-controlled, time-sensitive transportation of frozen foods, juice concentrates, perishable commodities, household and retail commodities, and tropical foliage in the United States.
Shares of Aasche closed at 4-9/16 yesterday.
